title: A chain build gives 9b 2 and 4 minutes, and a slot the plan never decided costs no fix round
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed and a test Postgres in TEST_DATABASE_URL, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The bench's repair clock keeps 10 and 12 minutes; a chain build's stops new work at 2 minutes and returns by 4.
A slot the plan neither writes nor hides is left out of the copy and W02 passes; a missing kept slot still sends the run to a fix round.

tests: step 9b keeps its 10 and 12 minute windows on the bench; a chain build gives it 2 and 4, cut shorter only by the deadline
a slot the plan neither writes nor hides is left out of the copy, not sent back for a fix round
an unknown slot the writer wrote is left out before the check, and a fix round return turns a kept slot into a return
